## Problem Description

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing. For example: "I need to parse HTML fragments but the API only supports full documents."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of the feature or change you would like to see.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered, and why they are insufficient.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, code examples, or references that help illustrate the request.
